creator: nocturne
statement: King Doot is a World 2 mini boss located in the Sands of Time second to last zone of Yum-Yum Desert

creator: nocturne
statement: Summoning King Doot requires a Dootjat Eye crafted at the Anvil

creator: nocturne
statement: Dootjat Eye requires 1 Silver Antique and 80 Gold Bars and a Ghost

creator: nocturne
statement: Silver Antique is bought from a vendor in Encroaching Forest Villas; limited to 1 per day

creator: nocturne
statement: The 80 Gold Bars come from Mining and Forging

creator: nocturne
statement: Ghost is a rare drop from Moonmen in the Up Down zone one zone before Sands of Time

creator: nocturne
statement: Craft the Dootjat Eye at the Anvil then bring it to the Sands of Time to summon a portal to the boss room

creator: nocturne
statement: First kill requires bringing 2 other people with you

creator: nocturne
statement: First kill needs one Warrior and one Archer and one Mage

creator: nocturne
statement: Any subclass counts for the base class such as Barbarian or Squire for Warrior

creator: nocturne
statement: Bowmen and Hunter count for the Archer class

creator: nocturne
statement: Wizard and Shaman count for the Mage class

creator: nocturne
statement: Boss room needs 500 Accuracy for 5% hit chance and 1500 Accuracy for 100% hit chance

creator: nocturne
statement: The Dootjat Eye is consumed each time you open the portal

creator: nocturne
statement: Each class stands in front of its pillar and types in chat to activate the speech bubble

creator: nocturne
statement: After the first kill the Dootophone is a 100% drop and lets you bypass needing the other 2 classes

creator: nocturne
statement: Click and hold the Dootophone to summon the boss

creator: nocturne
statement: Boss summons a line of fire and walks doing damage and has a bouncing spike ball

creator: nocturne
statement: Spike ball bounces in the same pattern so you can stay in a safe spot

creator: nocturne
statement: If you chase the boss blue flames periodically come at you

creator: nocturne
statement: Even with over 300 Defense the boss hits for 13 to 20 per hit

creator: nocturne
statement: Bring food with you especially if fighting this earlier in the game

creator: nocturne
statement: Main drops are the Efaunt Key which is near guaranteed but can miss sometimes

creator: nocturne
statement: He normally drops Gems and has a good chance of dropping Time Candy

creator: nocturne
statement: Midnight Cookie drop is used to craft Efaunt Armor later in World 2

creator: nocturne
statement: Trimmed Rune Platelegs are one of the best World 2 armors with 4 Strength and 2 Agility and 20 Defense and 10% Defense to all armor

creator: nocturne
statement: Trimmed Rune Platelegs are a fairly rare drop at about 1 in 25 chance
